id.description: The string or {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting} to represent the item's unique ID.

label.description: The string or {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting} to represent the item's label.

icon.description:
The string or {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting} to represent the icon of the item.
(e.g. "folder", "file", "house")

subItems.description: Array of children that the subItems has.

active.description: Boolean to control if the section is open

expanded.description: The string or {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting} to represent the expanded state of the item.

redirectLink.description: The {@link UiSdlRoute} or {@link UiSdlFieldBasedDataSpecSetting} to represent the route to redirect to when an item is clicked.

disabledReason.description:
Reason for being disabled - includes translation key and variables for tooltip.
Structure: { translationKey: string, translationVars?: Record<string, string> }

disabled.description: Whether or not the current item is disabled
